slots.label: SAP instance A (Americas)
slots.scope: Company codes 1000, 1200 · purchasing orgs 1000, 1200 · Detroit, Cleveland, Monterrey

slots.label: SAP instance B (Europe & Asia)
slots.scope: Company codes 2000, 2200 · purchasing orgs 2000, 2200 · Stuttgart, Munich, Suzhou

slots.label: Procurement suite (Ariba / Coupa style)
slots.scope: Indirect requisitions and approvals, sourcing events and indirect contracts for every company code

slots.label: Supplier portal (PO collaboration)
slots.scope: PO confirmations and advance ship notices from portal-enabled suppliers

slots.label: AP automation / invoice capture
slots.scope: Every supplier invoice as received: channel, touchless, exceptions, duplicates

slots.label: Bank payments (pain.001 / camt.053)
slots.scope: Outgoing supplier payments on the four house-bank accounts

slots.label: Supplier risk intelligence (D&B / EcoVadis style)
slots.scope: Financial stress, failure risk, sanctions screening and ESG for the supplier base

ECC.name: SAP ECC 6.0
ECC.note: MM and FI-AP tables via SLT, Openflow or a replication partner: EBAN, EKKO/EKPO/EKET (POs and contracts), MKPF/MSEG, RBKP/RSEG, BSIK/BSAK, REGUH/REGUP (payment runs), LFA1/LFB1.

S4.name: SAP S/4HANA
S4.note: S/4 tables: MATDOC replaces MKPF/MSEG, payables come from the Universal Journal ACDOCA (with NETDT and SK1DT), BUT000 business partners; EBAN, EKKO/EKPO, RBKP/RSEG and REGUH/REGUP as in ECC.

BW.name: SAP BW/4HANA
BW.note: Purchasing ADSOs (0PUR style: PO items, invoice receipts, goods receipts, contracts) and FI-AP vendor line items (0FIAP_O03 style). No requisitions, no payment runs and no cash-discount terms.

BDC.name: SAP BDC
BDC.note: Zero-copy SAP BDC data products: Supplier, PurchaseRequisition, PurchaseOrder, PurchaseContract, SupplierInvoice, EntryViewJournalEntry. No goods receipts (so no 3-way match or supplier OTIF) and no payment runs.

PROCUREMENT_SUITE.name: Procurement suite (Ariba / Coupa style)
PROCUREMENT_SUITE.note: Guided-buying requisitions with approvals (catalog, free text, sourcing request), sourcing events with baseline and awarded spend, and indirect contracts. POs are created in SAP and written back.

SUPPLIER_PORTAL.name: Supplier portal (PO collaboration)
SUPPLIER_PORTAL.note: Supplier-entered PO confirmations (promised date and quantity) and advance ship notices, keyed by the SAP PO number and line.

AP_AUTOMATION.name: AP automation / invoice capture
AP_AUTOMATION.note: Every supplier invoice as received (EDI, portal, PDF / OCR, paper) with touchless flag, exceptions and resolution, duplicate checks and the SAP invoice it was posted as.

BANK_PAYMENTS.name: Bank payments (pain.001 / camt.053)
BANK_PAYMENTS.note: Outgoing supplier payments as initiated (pain.001) and debited (camt.053), keyed by the SAP payment document; de-duplicated against REGUH. Also carries payments made outside the SAP payment run.

SUPPLIER_RISK.name: Supplier risk intelligence (D&B / EcoVadis style)
SUPPLIER_RISK.note: Financial stress and failure scores by D-U-N-S number, sanctions and adverse-media screening by tax id, and ESG ratings.

profiles.name: SAP SLT / direct replication
profiles.note: Native table and column names and types, as SAP SLT, Snowflake Openflow or a replication partner configured for native shape lands them. Today's bronze.

profiles.name: Fivetran
profiles.vendor: Fivetran (SAP ERP on HANA, SAP NetWeaver, SAP OData connectors)
profiles.note: Uppercase names; '/' in SAP namespaces becomes '_'. Adds _FIVETRAN_SYNCED; soft-delete mode adds _FIVETRAN_DELETED, history mode adds _FIVETRAN_ACTIVE/_START/_END, no-trigger mode _FIVETRAN_ID.

profiles.name: Qlik Replicate
profiles.vendor: Qlik Replicate / Qlik Cloud Data Integration (SAP Application, SAP HANA endpoints)
profiles.note: Native names. DATS/TIMS often land as text. Soft deletes via an operation_indicator column (default DELETE_FLAG = 'D'); Store Changes writes <table>__CT change tables with header__ columns, which are ignored.

profiles.name: Other ELT tool (configurable)
profiles.vendor: SNP Glue, Theobald Xtract, Informatica, AWS AppFlow, Azure Data Factory, ...
profiles.note: Set OPTIONS on CONFIG.INGESTION: table_prefix, audit_columns (regex), delete_column + delete_value, cast_text_types.
